summary: Numeric PIN pad with rippling keys and dot feedback: a wrong code shakes into red static, the right one sends a green wave.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: The expected PIN. Its length sets the number of dots. Compared in the browser.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Title above the dots. Read once on connect.

attributes.name: hint
attributes.description: Status text under the title. Defaults to `<n> digits`, where `<n>` is the length of `code`.

attributes.name: success
attributes.description: Status text after a correct PIN.

events.name: unlock
events.description: Fires when the entered digits match `code`.

events.name: error
events.description: Fires on a wrong PIN. `tries` is the number of attempts left: 2, 1, then 0. Does not bubble and is not composed: listen on the element itself, as the React `onError` prop does.

keyboard.action: Enter a digit while the pad or one of its keys has focus.

accessibility: The pad is a focusable `role="group"` labelled `PIN entry`, so digit keys work without focusing a key.
Keys are native buttons; the delete key has `aria-label="Delete"`.
The dots have `role="img"` and an `aria-label` such as `2 of 4 digits entered`, updated on every key.
The status line under the title is an `aria-live="polite"` region: hint, wrong PIN with tries left, and success.
Ripples and dots are drawn on an `aria-hidden` canvas.
motion: With reduced motion, dots do not pop, a wrong PIN does not shake or jitter, and the status changes without rolling; key ripples, red static and the green wave remain.
notes: Demo control: `code` sits in the markup and is compared in the browser, so it provides no security. Check real PINs on a server and use the events for the UI.
The PIN is checked 160 ms after the last digit; a delete or clear within that time cancels the check. Entry clears 0.9 s after a wrong PIN and 2.4 s after a correct one.
After three wrong PINs the status reads `Too many attempts · try again later`, then the counter resets to three; there is no lockout.
`error` stays on the element, so it does not reach `window` or global `error` handlers such as error-tracking scripts. `unlock` bubbles and is composed.
The pad is a fixed 236px wide and the host is `inline-block`.
